name: AddLightningEx
notes: Returned a placeholder handle in place of nothing in 3 cases of the nullability sweep (codeName: empty string, codeName: unknown name, checkVisibility: true, points unseen) on 3.0.0.24268: id 0, so a nil check does not catch it. It was the same `lightning` each time, so a nil check does not tell that the code name is unknown or the points are unseen. jassdoc documents these cases as returning nothing.
